item.description: The current implementation of _read_vol_str does not properly handle comma-separated user lists in volume access specifications. The test failure shows "list of users is not comma-separated or contains invalid characters" when processing user lists with spaces.
item.contract: Update the _read_vol_str method to properly parse user lists that may contain spaces, ensuring commas are used as separators and spaces are trimmed appropriately. The method should accept user lists like "user1, user2, user3" and correctly process them.

item.description: The idp_checkin method does not properly create dynamic volumes for IdP users and groups. The test expects volumes to be created when idp_checkin is called, but the current implementation does not correctly implement this functionality.
item.contract: Implement the idp_checkin method to properly create and manage dynamic volumes for IdP users and groups according to the expected test behavior. This includes creating appropriate volume structures and setting up permissions correctly.
item.acceptance: tests/test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_3, tests/test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_4, and tests/test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_5 should pass

item.description: The _read_vol_str method does not properly handle group references (e.g., @ga) in permission specifications. The current implementation treats them as literal strings rather than resolving them to individual users.
item.contract: Modify _read_vol_str to recognize and process group references like "@group" by expanding them to individual users during permission parsing. This requires implementing proper group membership resolution logic.

item.description: The VFS.add method does not properly handle breadth-first volume construction for nested paths. This causes incorrect volume creation and permission inheritance for complex nested volume structures.
item.contract: Fix the VFS.add method to properly handle breadth-first volume creation for nested paths, ensuring that permissions and volume structures are correctly maintained when creating nested volumes.

item.description: The VFS.get method does not properly handle dotfile access permissions for users. The test failure shows issues with dotfile access patterns, suggesting improper validation of dotfile permissions.
item.contract: Update the VFS.get method to properly validate and handle dotfile access permissions, ensuring that users with appropriate permissions can access dotfiles while others are properly restricted.
